verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing claims a built-in AI layer, Clara Intelligence, described as an 'automated CFO agent' and an 'AI partner' that delivers spend insights. However, this is only one-line homepage copy focused on insights, not documented task delegation. Clara MCP lets an external assistant act on Clara data, which is a different capability from a built-in assistant and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product assistant interface, evidence that users can delegate actions (not just receive insights), a list of supported tasks, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
